title: Account Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible **Account Executive** to join our corporate office. The candidate will be responsible for day-to-day accounting activities, maintaining financial records, reconciliations, and supporting the finance team in managing accounts for our hotel properties.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle day-to-day accounting and financial transactions.
* Maintain purchase, sales, expense, and payment records.
* Prepare and maintain invoices, vouchers, and supporting documents.
* Perform bank, ledger, and vendor reconciliations.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable.
* Assist with GST, TDS, and other statutory accounting requirements.
* Verify bills and supporting documents before processing payments.
* Coordinate with hotel properties, vendors, and internal departments regarding accounts-related matters.
* Maintain accurate records and ensure timely accounting entries.
* Assist in monthly closing and preparation of financial reports.
* Support the Finance Manager/Accounts Head with accounting and audit requirements.
* Ensure proper documentation and filing of financial records.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Commerce, Accounting, or Finance**.
* **2–4 years of experience** in Accounts/Finance.
* Candidates with **hotel/hospitality industry experience will be preferred**.
* Good knowledge of accounting principles and GST/TDS.
* Experience with **Tally/ERP/accounting software**.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
